narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved across northern Illinois during the afternoon and evening of August 14th producing a weak landspout tornado and a few funnel clouds. Heavy rain caused localized flash flooding in parts of Chicago.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding in parts of Chicago. The viaduct on the 31st Street exit from northbound Interstate 55 was flooded with a car stalled in the flood water. High water was reported on Interstate 55 between Damen Avenue and Ashland Avenue. A viaduct was flooded with cars stuck in the flood waters near North Lawndale. A video showed flooded viaducts on Ogden Avenue just west of Western Avenue. Water was several feet deep with a couple of cars in the flood waters.
